decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - 1/ The proposed extensions, due to their size, position and appearance, and when taken together with the existing extensions and outbuildings at the property, would represent an obtrusive and un-neighbourly over-development of the site, which would result in enclosure and loss of outlook to the rear of the neighbouring properties. The existing and proposed extensions would fail to be secondary to the size of the original house and would detract from the original shape and character of the pair of semi-detached properties, detrimental to the appearance of the streetscene and detrimental to local residential amenity, contrary to Adopted UDP policies ENV.1.1, H.3.4 and Revised Deposit Policies ENV-B.1.1 and H.6.4. (January 2001) and the Residential Extension Guidelines (July 2002).
description: ERECTION OF A TWO-STOREY SIDE EXTENSION, PART SINGLE-STOREY REAR  EXTENSION AND PART FIRST FLOOR REAR EXTENSION TO DWELLINGHOUSE
